name: Muy Moderna
description: Uruguayan online store selling imported kitchen, organization, cleaning, car accessory, personal care, garden, tools, toys and pet items. Ships to all of Uruguay with a pickup point in Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de artículos importados de organización, cocina, limpieza, accesorios de auto, cuidado personal, jardín, herramientas, juguetes y mascotas. Envía a todo Uruguay y tiene punto de retiro en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: All of Uruguay; Montevideo usually delivered within 24 h of processing, interior about 48 h via agencies (mainly UES, sometimes DAC); processing takes 24 business hours

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup point and physical store in Montevideo, open Monday to Saturday per the shipping policy page.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: Nationwide coverage, carriers, delivery times, Montevideo pickup point
